rulepack.label: ACM0002: Grid-connected electricity generation from renewable sources (Solar PV)

rules.title: Net electricity exported (EG_facility,y) is missing
rules.message: No authoritative value found for net electricity exported to the grid (EG_facility,y). {detail}
rules.remediation: Provide net generation and export data substantiated by calibrated meter logs and utility billing receipts.

rules.title: Grid emission factor (EF_grid,CM,y) is missing
rules.message: No authoritative value found for the combined margin grid emission factor (EF_grid,CM,y). {detail}
rules.remediation: Document the published CEA/national grid emission factor applied to the monitoring period with reference citation.
rules.clause_ref: Tool 07 (Tool to calculate the emission factor for an electricity system)

rules.title: Monitoring period start date is missing
rules.message: No verified start date recorded for this monitoring interval. {detail}
rules.remediation: State the exact start date on the monitoring cover page and reconciliation schedule.
rules.clause_ref: CDM Project Standard for Monitoring, Section 6

rules.title: Monitoring period end date is missing
rules.message: No verified end date recorded for this monitoring interval. {detail}
rules.remediation: State the exact end date covering the full monitoring cycle.
rules.clause_ref: CDM Project Standard for Monitoring, Section 6

rules.title: Monitoring period boundary dates inverted
rules.message: The monitoring period end date does not follow the start date. Observed {observed}.
rules.remediation: Correct chronological dates across the monitoring report and meter records.

rules.title: Reported document date span misaligned with monitoring period
rules.message: {subject} in the document is {observed} but the registered period is {expected}.
rules.remediation: Ensure all evidence spans cover the exact approved monitoring interval without truncation.

rules.title: Incompatible energy unit for net export
rules.message: Net export unit mismatch. Observed {observed}, expected canonical {expected}.
rules.remediation: Report export figures in MWh (or clearly state conversion factor from kWh/GWh).

rules.title: Incompatible unit for grid emission factor
rules.message: Emission factor unit mismatch. Observed {observed}, expected canonical {expected}.
rules.remediation: Express emission factor as tCO2/MWh (or kgCO2/MWh with stated conversion).

rules.title: Installed capacity outside plausible boundaries
rules.message: Installed capacity {observed} is outside expected grid-scale envelope {expected}.
rules.remediation: Confirm nameplate DC capacity and grid interconnection inverter limit against the PPA.

rules.title: Cross-document discrepancy in net exported electricity
rules.message: Conflicting values extracted across source documents for net export: {observed}.
rules.remediation: Reconcile discrepancies between plant SCADA, Joint Meter Readings (JMR), and state utility invoices.

rules.title: Monthly meter readings do not reconcile with annual total
rules.message: The sum of 12 monthly meter readings does not match annual reported net export. Observed {observed}.
rules.remediation: Correct monthly aggregation errors or identify unmetered transmission losses.

rules.title: Claimed emission reductions deviate from recomputation
rules.message: Claimed emission reductions {observed} do not equal EG_export * EF_grid {expected}.
rules.remediation: Recalculate baseline emissions using verified net generation and published CEA emission factor.
